In his Super Tuesday victory speech, former President Donald Trump elevated false information that had gone viral on social media, claiming the Biden administration secretly flew hundreds of thousands of migrants into the United States.
Many post sharing the claim referred to a report by the Center for Immigration Studies, a group that advocates for immigration restrictions.

It said the administration refused to list individual airports where people arrived under a Biden “parole” program that allows Cubans, Haitians, Nicaraguans and Venezuelans to stay in the U.S. for two years.
U.S. Customs and Border Protection each month publishes the number of migrants admitted under the program by nationality.
This information is available on its website and in press releases.
It does not list arriving airports.
